name: smwsprites-bopping-toady-v1
title: Bopping Toady v1.0
description:
This is a simple sprite that moves only by jumping. It can attack by extending its tongue. Its interaction is very standard. It has an option for using an alternate palette underwater, which might be useful if you want it to look more blue or something like that.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by Yoshin.
